status: post-open source diagnostic on the previously examined PhysTwin-22 cohort
claim_boundary: This experiment can test whether automatic prefix RGB-D correspondence adds to the already selected object-disjoint MatPhys plus Bayesian overlay. All 22 outcomes were opened previously, so a pass authorizes only a genuinely fresh public-object source panel and cannot establish independent transfer or state of the art.

physical_baseline.description: object-disjoint MatPhys spring family selected from the allowed prefix, followed by the frozen within-family Bayesian-anchor or last-residual overlay

decision_arms.fixed_control_note: The legacy source key contains manual_override, but manual_prefix_override is false, so no manual observation is applied. The analyzer enforces this boundary.

forbidden: using any manual trajectory before the future evaluation
using future RGB, depth, point clouds, or manual trajectories to form or select a prediction
selecting a different broad-runner candidate after reading this result
modifying the frozen Deform360 v6.1 candidate or scorer
using held-v8 runtime, target, query, score, barrier, or outcome artifacts
calling a passing opened-cohort result independent evidence or state of the art
